newDraft.segmentsHint: About one scene per 5 seconds of music keeps the pace — a 40-second track ≈ 8 scenes. Not every scene needs a voice: silent scenes are carried by the music and the images.
newDraft.topicPlaceholder: E.g. Our single "Northern Lights" drops Friday August 15 — pre-save now
newDraft.targetAudiencePlaceholder: E.g. People who listen to melancholic synthpop and Nordic indie
newDraft.problemPlaceholder: E.g. New music drowns in the feed without promo that stands out
newDraft.title: Create promo video
newDraft.subtitle: Tell us what the video is about — you approve everything before anything costs money.
newDraft.outroDesc: A closing frame with your link (website/Linktree), artist image and call to action — e.g. "Pre-save on Spotify". Without a jingle ~3 seconds; with a jingle as long as the jingle (up to 10 sec).

home.hero_a: Promo for your music, in minutes.
home.hero_em: Made from what you already have.
home.hero_sub: Tell us about the release, the show or the song. You get a finished promo video with your own music underneath, your own images and a voice that ties it together -- ready for TikTok, Reels and YouTube.
home.feat_sub: From idea to posted promo -- no editing software, no design skills.
home.f1_d: Your photos become moving scenes with camera motion and lip-sync. 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 -- the same promo for every feed.
home.f2_d: Use your own tracks as the soundtrack -- one song, or several crossfaded into a medley. The film follows the music, not the other way around.
home.f3_d: Live clips from the phone drop straight into a scene. Mix them with generated ones, or use only your own.
home.f4_d: Straight to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok -- with a calendar, so the teaser lands the day before the release, not the week after.
home.f5_t: See the cost as you go
home.f5_d: Every choice shows its price while you work, with your balance next to it. Nothing is charged before you approve it.
home.f6_d: Each single, album or tour keeps its own images, voices and clips -- and everything you have made stays reusable.
home.foot_tag: Promo for artists -- video, voice and your own music.
home.ill2_text: New single out Friday — three years in the making.
